pr_title: streamingest: add replication states for `init` and `cutover`
pr_body:
Adding 2 new tenant states: `INITIALIZING REPLICATION ` and `REPLICATION CUTTING OVER`.

Adding the cutover time to the `SHOW TENANT WITH REPLICATION` command.

See the commits for more info.

Fixes: #94707

Epic: CRDB-18752

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/94011)
~and note that the first 3 commits are from PR #93755~

issue_context.title: c2c: add INIT and CUTOVER states
issue_context.body:
`INITIALIZING REPLICATION` - the state of the destination cluster until the initial scan is done. cutover cannot be done when the destination cluster is at this state.

`REPLICATION CUTTING OVER` - the state of the destination cluster during a cutover.

Also, print the cutover timestamp in SHOW TEANT WITH REPLICATION.

Jira issue: CRDB-23096


Epic CRDB-18749
